Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.casts

Interface AttributeEncrypter

public interface AttributeEncrypter
Encrypts and decrypts the text of an encrypted cast attribute; the model supplies it.

Diwan does no cryptography: the algorithm, the keys and key rotation belong to the implementation. encrypt(java.lang.String) receives the text to store (the JSON text for the json, array, collection and object forms) and returns the text the column holds. The column must be a text type, and an encrypted column cannot be searched with where.

Implementation Requirements:
Implementations must be safe to share across threads, and decrypt(java.lang.String) must accept what encrypt(java.lang.String) returned, including output made under an earlier key when hasPreviousKeys() is true. An exception thrown by encrypt or decrypt, and a missing encrypter, reach the caller as an InvalidCastException whose cause is the original exception (same instance). An implementation should not throw InvalidCastException; the model rethrows that type as it is.

    • hasPreviousKeys

      default boolean hasPreviousKeys()
      Reports whether stored values may be encrypted under keys other than the current one.

      While this returns true, an encrypted attribute whose stored text changed is dirty even when the decrypted value is the same, so the next save re-encrypts it under the current key. An encrypted JSON value that was read is written back on the next dirty check, so it also turns dirty.

      Returns:
      true if earlier keys are still accepted by decrypt(java.lang.String)
      Implementation Requirements:
      The default returns false.
